name: B6 Studios
scope: GENERAL outreach only — the wide net. NEVER touch Surviving the Cows, Trashed, or 7 Stories named targets (those are Avi's manual sniper pipelines). Dedupe against them before every send.

targeting.notes: Consumer-facing brands ~$20M+ revenue that already make content or obviously should, with a product/world a short-form series could be built around. Match the ask to seniority: director level and above; never aim a six-figure concept at a coordinator.

market_crosscheck._note: consumer-brand NAICS (food/beverage/apparel/toiletries/clothing-retail) as a STARTER approximation of the B6 ICP — Avi/ops should refine which NAICS truly match.

_needs_from_avi.compliance: a real physical postal address and a working unsubscribe URL for the CAN-SPAM footer. outreach-write appends them to every body; the deliver step refuses to send without them.
_needs_from_avi.economics: (optional) avg_deal_value_usd — the average value of a closed sponsored/co-developed series. Lets the business dashboard value the pipeline (won/SOM/TAM) in dollars. Without it the dashboard shows counts only.
_needs_from_avi.sending.domains: one or more cold sending-domain objects {domain, spf, dkim, dmarc, warmup_status, from_addresses, daily_cap}, separate from b6studios.com (SPEC §8). NEVER send from b6studios.com / mason@b6studios.com. The deliver step only sends from a domain whose warmup_status is 'ready' — warming is a ~2-4 week field-value change, not a missing capability.
_needs_from_avi.reply_to: a monitored reply inbox on the cold domain (SPEC §8 reply routing).
_needs_from_avi.calendar_url: the Mason + Weston 15-min booking link (SPEC §7 step 7).
_needs_from_avi.success: target booked-meeting rate and a defensible max cost per meeting, defined up front (SPEC §9).
_needs_from_avi.host_base_url: the domain/CDN that serves per-brand teaser links with view tracking (SPEC §7 step 4).
